reason: Both correctly identify the flashing 'U' as 'no suitable pan detected', propose the magnet test as the sensible first step and confirm the hob is fine once the cast-iron casserole works. Conversation 1 closes cleanly with practical cookware guidance (flat, magnetic bases) and no unjustified escalation or part talk. Conversation 2 appends irrelevant boilerplate about tripping electrics and burning smells, and then a 'check a suitable replacement / enter your model number' panel that wrongly implies a part is needed for a brand-new, correctly working hob - contradicting its own 'it is just your pans' conclusion and potentially sending the homeowner down a pointless path. Conversation 1 is therefore more honest and better targeted, though neither mentions the induction adapter disc option.
